messages.content:
Traveller: I'd really like to take my client out to a nice restaurant that serves indian food.
Assistant: I show many restaurants that serve Indian food in that price range. What area would you like to travel to?
Traveller: I am looking for an expensive indian restaurant in the area of centre.
Assistant: Might I recommend Saffron Brasserie? That is an expensive Indian restaurant in the center of town. I can book a table for you, if you like.
Traveller: Sure thing, please book for 6 people at 19:30 on Saturday.
Assistant: Booking was successful. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. Your Reference number is : RF00JUFQ.
Traveller: Okay great! Thank you so much. Could you also help me find a 3 star hotel in the area. I don't need wifi either.
Assistant: The alpha-milton guest house is in the north and is moderately priced. It has 3 stars and no internet or parking. Would you like to book a room?
Traveller: That sounds great. Please book that now.
Assistant: May I ask how many people are in your group?
Traveller: I have 6 people in my group.
Assistant: How many days would you like to stay?
Traveller: 2 nights, starting the same day as the reservation.
Assistant: I'm sorry. It looks like they're full. Would you like me to look for something else?
Traveller: Yes please. Is there something else available in that area?
Assistant: I'm sorry, it looks like that is the only 3 star hotel in that area, would you like me to look somewhere else?
Traveller: Can we try for 1 night instead of 2? I'll need the reference number please.
Assistant: I was able to get one night, the reference number is 9XVT8M5T.
Traveller: Thank you so much!
Assistant: I'm glad to help, you're welcome!
